svg.title: Animated web_agent architecture
svg.desc: Animated architecture diagram. The five How It Works stages highlight sequentially in an infinite loop. Only the matching main-agent connector animates: start to before_agent, before_agent to Model, Model to Tools, and Model to after_agent. The observation-to-Model back connector is never animated. No How It Works connectors animate, the decorative dotted loop beneath How It Works is removed, and Respond has no animated connector.
